title: Econ 148 — Climate & Conflict Replication (PNAS 2009)
subtitle: Reproducing core results from Burke et al. (2009)
summary: End-to-end replication of climate–civil war results in Sub-Saharan Africa: data cleaning, OLS with fixed effects and clustered SEs, robustness checks, and reproducible outputs.

title: Econ 148 — Table Models (Models 1–3)
subtitle: Temperature & precipitation effects with FE and clustered SEs
summary: Implements three OLS specifications with country and year fixed effects; examines multicollinearity, adds precipitation controls, and compiles a clean combined results table.

title: Econ 148 — Figure 1 Uncertainty Panels
subtitle: Climate-only, regression-only, and combined uncertainty
summary: Recreates the three uncertainty panels for conflict risk under warming scenarios; documents bootstrap strategy, parameter draws, and assumptions behind projections.

title: Econ 148 — Burke et al. (2009) Replication Final Project
subtitle: Climate change and civil war in Sub-Saharan Africa
summary: Full replication of Burke et al. (2009) on climate change and civil war in Africa. Includes data cleaning, econometric models with fixed effects and clustered SEs, and reproduction of core tables and figures from the original paper.
